_comment: Pinned harness-side driver versions. This manifest is separate from build_artifacts/, which holds engines and binary bridges. Install dependencies as documented in docs/RUNNING.md; verify them with `python3 -m runner.run doctor`.

puppeteer-core.notes: puppeteer-core is pinned instead of the puppeteer meta-package so the harness installs no bundled Chromium and exposes no auto-launch fallback.

chrome-remote-interface.notes: Protocol-direct Node client. `local: true` uses the bundled protocol descriptor instead of fetching `/json/protocol`, which candidate engines may not serve.

cdp-use.used_by: thin_cdp_use driver (runner/scripts/adapters/cdp_use_adapter.py, CDPClient.send_raw over the browser websocket)
cdp-use.notes: Typed Python CDP client from the browser-use ecosystem. Install it into the Python 3.11+ environment that runs the benchmark.

stagehand.notes: Uses Stagehand's deterministic page, locator, and evaluate surface only; no model client is configured. Connect-only mode drives the supplied endpoint and does not launch a fallback browser. The optional Puppeteer peer is unused.

chrome-devtools-mcp.used_by: mcp_chrome_devtools driver (runner/scripts/adapters/cdt_mcp_adapter.js spawns the MCP server with --wsEndpoint <browser_ws> and speaks MCP JSON-RPC over its stdio)
chrome-devtools-mcp.notes: Connect-only mode (`--wsEndpoint`) never launches a browser. Selector-to-uid resolution uses `take_snapshot` plus one batched `evaluate_script` lookup. Because the server exposes no raw-CDP tool, the live-transport identity check compares `navigator.userAgent` with `/json/version`.

pydoll-python.notes: The adapter exercises Pydoll's high-level `go_to`, `refresh`, `WebElement.click`, and `insert_text` surface rather than bypassing it with raw CDP.

chromedp.used_by: thin_chromedp driver (runner/scripts/adapters/chromedp_adapter, `go run` against the committed go.mod/go.sum pin; NewRemoteAllocator + NoModifyURL)
chromedp.notes: The adapter exercises chromedp's high-level Navigate, Click, SendKeys, Text, and Value actions. The committed go.mod declares the required Go toolchain; adapter code keeps the connection-owning context alive across operations.

rod.used_by: thin_rod driver (runner/scripts/adapters/rod_adapter, `go run` against the committed go.mod/go.sum pin; rod.New().ControlURL(browser_ws))
rod.notes: The adapter exercises Rod's own Browser.Page, Navigate, Element.Click, and Input surface, with each wait clamped to the task budget.

chromiumoxide.used_by: thin_chromiumoxide driver (runner/scripts/adapters/chromiumoxide_adapter, `cargo run --manifest-path` against the committed Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock pin; Browser::connect(browser_ws))
chromiumoxide.notes: Async Rust CDP driver. Build the committed Cargo manifest and lockfile with the minimum Rust version declared under language_runtimes.

ferrum.notes: The adapter exercises Ferrum's create_page, go_to, Node#click, Node#type, and evaluate surface. It does not call quit on a browser supplied through `ws_url`.

selenium.used_by: webdriver_selenium driver (runner/scripts/adapters/selenium_adapter.py, webdriver.Chrome with debugger_address attach + execute_cdp_cmd gate)
selenium.notes: Selenium drives through ChromeDriver's WebDriver facade. ChromeDriver attaches to the running engine through `debuggerAddress`; inability to attach is recorded as a structured compatibility result.

chromedriver.used_by: webdriver_selenium driver (spawned per attempt on a free port by selenium_adapter.py)
chromedriver.notes: Stored under build_artifacts/ and verified by version plus sha256 prefix. An activated engine set may override this fallback pin with its matching ChromeDriver.

agent-browser.used_by: l1.agent_browser_tool subset (runner/scripts/l1_ab_probe.js) and the tool_agent_browser scenario column (runner/scripts/adapters/ab_scenario_adapter.js), both via AB_BIN

devtools-protocol.used_by: CDP stable-surface coverage matrix (runner/coverage.py; `python3 -m runner.run coverage`)
devtools-protocol.notes: Machine-readable CDP definition (browser_protocol.json + js_protocol.json). Already resolved as a transitive dependency of playwright-core/puppeteer-core and locked in package-lock.json; pinned explicitly here so the coverage denominator (stable domain × command/event universe) is reproducible. Bumping this revision re-baselines the gap list.

language_runtimes._comment: Runtimes required by the multi-language scenario adapters. `doctor` verifies presence and minimum versions before a run.

go.used_by: chromedp/rod adapters; module builds follow each adapter's committed go.mod toolchain directive
